description: Sprint 004A catalogue benchmark: wines a CELLR user may look for, with the query they might type and the identity they mean. Identities are written from general wine knowledge as search targets, not as facts imported anywhere; a provider 'covers' a wine only when its own record says so (see scripts/catalog-tools/benchmark.ts). Version 2 (Wine Intelligence WI-01) adds: more regions and price segments; near twins (the full name of one wine with the sibling it must not be confused with, `decoy`); perturbations of a fixed spread of the original entries (every 9th: an OCR confusion, a dropped letter, a hyphenated line break), which expect their base entry's record; filters (what is returned must satisfy the filter); very common words; and strings that must stay data. b001–b127 are unchanged, so results can be compared with Sprint 004A on the same queries.
